# Services-BGE

> Local embedding and reranking APIs for hybrid search on Apple Silicon Macs, plus tools to compare models on your own data. Serves BAAI/bge-m3 (dense 1024 + sparse lexical weights + ColBERT vectors in one pass) on http://127.0.0.1:9001/v1/embeddings (OpenAI-compatible; works with the official OpenAI SDK via base_url) and BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 on http://127.0.0.1:9002/v1/rerank (Cohere/Jina-style). Other models (Qwen3-Embedding, Qwen3-Reranker, multilingual-e5, any SentenceTransformer) run as sidecars from profiles/*.env; eval/run_eval.py measures recall, nDCG, MRR and HS-code accuracy. Sparse output is shaped for Qdrant sparse vectors. PyTorch MPS, launchd, Python 3.12, MIT license.
